Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
9.1.1 Design Thinking (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test)

blocks.prompt:
1 What is Design Thinking? Name its five steps.
(Design Thinking kya hai? Is ke paanch qadmon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Design Thinking aisa tareeqa hai jo masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhne aur seedha hal ki taraf jane ke bajaye pehle masla gehrai se samajhne mein madad deta hai. Paanch qadam: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype aur Test.

book_ref.quote: Design Thinking is a method that helps us to look at problems from different angles

blocks.prompt:
2 What is meant by the Empathize step? Give the book's example.
(Empathize ke qadam se kya murad hai? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Empathize ka matlab hai khud ko doosre ki jagah rakh kar us ke ehsasat, zarooraton aur mushkilat ko samajhna. Misal: naya school bag banate waqt students se poochna ke unhein apne mojooda bag mein kya pasand aur kya na-pasand hai.

book_ref.quote: you would talk to students to learn what they like and dislike about their current bags

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between the Ideate and Prototype steps of Design Thinking.
(Design Thinking ke Ideate aur Prototype qadmon mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ideate mein bohat se khayalat bante hain; Prototype mein aik khayal ka jaldi saada model banta hai.

book_ref.quote: you might create a basic model using cardboard, fabric, or even paper

rows: Har mumkin hal ka brainstorm
Khayal ka saada namoona jaldi banana
Khayalat ke mukammal hone ki fikr nahi
Dikhata hai ke khayal kaisa lagega
Bag misal: extra padding, ya kitabon ke khane
Bag misal: gatte, kapre ya kaghaz ka saada model

blocks.prompt:
4 What is done in the Test step of Design Thinking?
(Design Thinking ke Test qadam mein kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prototype ko check kiya jata hai ke theek kaam karta hai ya nahi, jaise students se bag istemal karwa kar raye lena. Un ki raye par behtari karte rehte hain jab tak masla hal karne wala aakhri product na ban jaye.

book_ref.quote: Based on their comments, you can make improvements until you have a final product

blocks.prompt:
5 What are business solutions? Give the book's grocery store example.
(Business solutions kya hain? Kitab ki grocery store wali misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Business solutions companies ko masail hal karne aur behtar kaam karne ke tareeqe hain. Misal: grocery store ki cheezein aksar khatam ho jati hon to zyada jaldi order kare ya inventory track karne ka software lagaye, taake shelves bhari rahein aur customers khush rahein.

book_ref.quote: a business solution could be to order more frequently or use software to track inventory

blocks.prompt:
6 Give a reason: business solutions are not just about fixing problems.
(Wajah batayein: business solutions sirf masail theek karne ke liye nahi hote.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kaarobar ko barhne aur behtar hone mein bhi madad dete hain. Misal: zyada customers online khareedne lagein to dukaan home delivery shuru kar sakti hai, taake kaarobar tabdeeliyon ke saath chale aur taraqqi kare.

book_ref.quote: Business solutions are not just about fixing problems; they also help businesses grow and improve

blocks.text: 9.1.3 How Does Design Thinking Apply to Business Solutions?

blocks.prompt:
7 How can a company use Design Thinking to build a food-ordering app?
(Company khana mangwane ki app banane ke liye Design Thinking kaise istemal kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Design Thinking companies ko woh products banane mein madad deti hai jo log waqai chahte hain. User ke tajurbe par tawajjuh aur mukhtalif khayalat test kar ke company aisi app bana sakti hai jo aasan bhi ho aur market mein kamyab bhi.

book_ref.quote: Design Thinking helps companies create products and services that people actually want and need

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a business plan? Why is it called a map?
(Business plan kya hai? Ise naqsha kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Business plan aisa document hai jo kaarobari khayal, use kamyab banane ka mansooba aur maqasid ke qadam bayan karta hai. Yeh naqshe ki tarah hai kyunke batata hai ke kya karna hai, kaise karna hai aur kaise kamyab hona hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps you plan out what you want to do, how you will do it, and how you will succeed

blocks.text: 9.2.2 Key Parts of a Business Plan

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between the Executive Summary and the Business Description of a business plan.
(Business plan ki Executive Summary aur Business Description mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Executive Summary poore plan ka mukhtasar jaiza hai; Business Description khud kaarobar ko samjhati hai.

book_ref.quote: It includes what your business does, your goals, and how you plan to achieve them

rows: Kaarobari khayal ka mukhtasar jaiza
Batati hai ke kaarobar kis bare mein hai
Kaarobar kya karta hai, maqasid aur unhein hasil karne ka tareeqa
Products ya services, target customers aur kaarobar ki inferadiyat
Plan ke ahem tareen nukaat samet-ti hai
Misal: mohalle mein taaza lemonade bechne wala stand

blocks.prompt:
10 What is included in the Market Analysis part of a business plan? Give an example.
(Business plan ke Market Analysis hisse mein kya hota hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Market Analysis dikhata hai ke aap apni market samajhte hain: mumkina customers kaun hain, unhein kya chahiye aur muqabil kaun hain. Misal: pet-sitting ke liye maloom karein ke ilaqe mein kitne pet owners hain aur kaun si doosri services hain.

book_ref.quote: This section shows that you understand your market

blocks.prompt:
11 What does the Financial Plan of a business plan contain?
(Business plan ke Financial Plan mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein maali maqasid aur unhein hasil karne ka tareeqa hota hai, budget, funding ki zaroorat aur mutawaqqa aamdani ke saath. Misal: supplies ke liye $100 chahiye to batayein ke kaise jama karenge aur badle mein kitna kamane ki umeed hai.

book_ref.quote: explain how you will raise this money and what you expect to earn in return

blocks.prompt:
12 What is described in the Products or Services part? Give the book's example.
(Products or Services wale hisse mein kya bayan hota hai? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Is mein batate hain ke aap kya bech rahe ya pesh kar rahe hain aur products ya services ki khoobiyan aur faide kya hain. Misal: tuition service ke liye batayein ke aap ke sabaq students ke grades kaise behtar karenge.

book_ref.quote: explain how your lessons will help students improve their grades

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the Organization and Management part of a business plan?
(Business plan ka Organization and Management hissa kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein batate hain ke kaarobar kaise munazzam hoga, team members aur un ke kirdar ke saath. Misal: school club ke liye batayein ke president, secretary aur doosre ohde kis ke paas honge.

book_ref.quote: Describe how your business will be organized

blocks.text: 9.2.3 Using Digital Tools to Create a Business Plan

blocks.prompt:
14 How have digital tools changed the creation of a business plan?
(Digital tools ne business plan banane ka amal kaise badla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Business plan banana naya kaarobar shuru karne ka ahem qadam hai. Digital tools ne is amal ko aasan aur karkardag bana diya hai aur plan mukammal aur professional banta hai. In mein business plan software aur team ke liye collaborative tools shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: digital tools have made this process more accessible and efficient

blocks.prompt:
15 What does business plan software provide? Name two such programs.
(Business plan software kya deta hai? Do programs ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh tarteeb wale templates, financial modeling features aur rehnumai deta hai; financial calculators kharche le kar andazan sales aur cash flow ki projections charts aur graphs ke saath banate hain. Misalein: PlanGuru aur Enloop.

book_ref.quote: These tools provide structured templates, financial modeling features, and guidance

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between business plan software and collaborative tools.
(Business plan software aur collaborative tools mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Business plan software plan ka mawad banane mein madad deta hai; collaborative tools kai logon ko mil kar likhne dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Collaborative tools allow multiple people to contribute to the plan simultaneously

rows: Templates, financial modeling aur rehnumai deta hai
Kai log aik waqt mein plan mein hissa daal sakte hain
Financial calculators sales aur cash flow ki projections banate hain
Commenting, suggestion modes aur version control dete hain
Misalein: PlanGuru, Enloop
Misalein: Google Drive, Dropbox Paper

blocks.prompt:
17 What are commenting/suggestion modes and version control in collaborative tools?
(Collaborative tools mein commenting/suggestion modes aur version control kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Commenting aur suggestion modes team members ko asal text badle baghair raye ya tabdeeli ki tajweez dene dete hain. Version control tabdeeliyan track karta aur zaroorat par pichhle draft par wapas jane deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Additionally, version control features help you track changes

blocks.prompt:
18 What is meant by collecting market insights?
(Market insights jama karne se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Market insights jama karne ka matlab hai target customers, muqabilon aur poore market ke mahol ki maloomat jama aur tajziya karna. Yeh insights kaarobari strategy, products aur marketing ke soche samjhe faisle karne mein madad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: These insights help you make informed decisions about your business strategy, products, and marketing efforts

blocks.prompt:
19 Define market research. Name its two main types.
(Market research ki definition likhein. Is ki do bari qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Market research us market ka data jama karne ka amal hai jis mein kaarobar chalta hai, taake customers ki zarooratein, pasand aur rawaiye aur muqabilon ki taqat aur kamzori samjhi ja sake. Qismein: qualitative aur quantitative.

book_ref.quote: There are two main types of market research techniques: qualitative and quantitative

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between qualitative and quantitative research.
(Qualitative aur quantitative research mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qualitative research batati hai customers aisa kyun karte hain; quantitative research naapti hai kitne ya kitna.

book_ref.quote: Unlike qualitative research, quantitative research involves collecting numerical data

rows: Customers ki wajoohat, aara aur muharrikat par tawajjuh
Customers ke rawaiye mein patterns aur trends pehchanna
Ghair-adadi data jama karti hai
Adadi data jama karti hai jo statistically parkha jata hai
Tareeqe: interviews, focus groups, mushahida
Tareeqa: surveys
Misal: pasandeeda bread aur pastries par gehri guftagu
Misal: log kitni dafa coffee khareedte aur kitna dete hain

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between customer surveys and focus groups.
(Customer surveys aur focus groups mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Surveys tay shuda sawalon se bohat logon tak pohanchte hain; focus groups chand logon se gehri guftagu karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They can be conducted online, over the phone, or in person

rows: Bari tadad mein customers se maloomat
Chhota aur mukhtalif logon ka group
Sawalon ka silsila jin ke customers jawab dete hain
Product, service ya concept par tafseeli guftagu
Online, phone par ya aamne saamne
Shurka mil kar, jaise bread aur pastries chakh kar
Pasand, rawaiye aur demographics ka data
Aara aur rawaiyon ki gehri samajh (qualitative data)

blocks.prompt:
22 What is market segmentation? Give an example.
(Market segmentation kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Market segmentation bari target market ko umar, aamdani ya khareedne ki aadaton ki bunyad par chhote groups mein baantna hai. Misal: kam umar customers meethi pastries aur bare umar wale whole-grain bread pasand karte hain, is liye har group ke liye products aur marketing badli jati hai.

book_ref.quote: You may discover that younger customers prefer sweet pastries

blocks.prompt:
23 What is competitor analysis? Give the book's bakery example.
(Competitor analysis kya hai? Kitab ki bakery misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Competitor analysis muqabilon ki taqat, kamzori, qeematon ki strategy aur customer feedback ka mutaala hai taake apne kaarobar ko mukhtalif banane ke mauqe milein. Misal: qareeb ki bakery artisanal bread ke liye mashhoor ho to aap gourmet pastries ya mausami cakes shamil karein.

book_ref.quote: you can identify opportunities to differentiate your business

blocks.prompt:
24 What is predictive analysis? How does it help a business?
(Predictive analysis kya hai? Yeh kaarobar ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Predictive analysis purane data se mustaqbil ke trends aur nataij ka andaza lagata hai. Agar sales data kisi product ki demand mein musalsal izafa dikhaye to aap paidawar barhate hain; is se pehle se faisle, kam khatra aur zyada mauqe milte hain.

book_ref.quote: Predictive analysis helps you make proactive decisions that align with future market conditions

blocks.prompt:
25 What is meant by data-driven decisions? Give an example.
(Data-driven decisions se kya murad hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Data-driven decisions market data ki insights par mabni soche samjhe faisle hain, jaise products chunna, qeemat rakhna aur marketing ki mansooba bandi. Misal: data dikhaye ke koi product kamzor hai to use band kar ke kamyab products par tawajjuh dein.

book_ref.quote: The primary aim of analyzing market data is to make well-informed decisions

blocks.prompt:
26 What is a business pitch? What three things would a juice shop pitch include?
(Business pitch kya hai? Juice shop ki pitch mein kaun si teen cheezein hongi?)
blocks.explanation:
Business pitch mukhtasar presentation hai jis mein kaarobari khayal samjhaya jata hai. Juice shop pitch mein:
1. Khayal kya hai: taaza, sehat mand aur saste juices ki dukaan
2. Customers kaun hain: mohalle ke sehat ka khayal rakhne wale log
3. Yeh kyun chalega: qareeb koi aur juice shop nahi

book_ref.quote: Imagine you have a great idea for a small business, like opening a new juice shop

blocks.prompt:
27 Name the five steps to pitching your idea.
(Apna khayal pitch karne ke paanch qadmon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Masle se shuru karein (Start with the Problem)
2. Apna hal pesh karein (Introduce Your Solution)
3. Batayein yeh munfarid kyun hai (Explain Why It's Unique)
4. Apni audience ko jaanein (Know Your Audience)
5. Sawalon ke liye tayyar rahein (Be Prepared to Answer Questions)

book_ref.quote: Be ready to explain more details, like how much the juices will cost

blocks.prompt:
28 Write the four parts of the book's web development service pitch.
(Kitab ki web development service pitch ke chaar hisse likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Problem: bohat se chhote kaarobar website na hone se customers nahi kheench pate.
2. Solution: un ke liye saada aur sasti websites banane wali service.
3. Unique Selling Point: chhote kaarobar ke liye, aasan designs, maqami zaban ki support.
4. Target Audience: local dukaan dar aur restaurant managers.

book_ref.quote: You decide to pitch an idea for a web development service aimed at helping these businesses go online

blocks.prompt:
29 Give a reason: a good pitch can make all the difference.
(Wajah batayein: achhi pitch bara farq daal sakti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Apna khayal pitch kar sakna woh support dilata hai jo khayal ko haqeeqat banane ke liye chahiye, chhota kaarobar ho ya bara project. Apple aur Google jaisi companies saada pitches se shuru huin jin se support aur sarmaya mila.

book_ref.quote: Whether you're starting a small business or launching a big project, a good pitch can make all the difference

blocks.prompt:
30 What is meant by understanding your market? Give an example.
(Apni market samajhne se kya murad hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Product ki marketing se pehle mumkina customers, un ki zarooratein aur product un zarooraton ko kaise poora karega, yeh pehchanna. Misal: riwayati Pakistani kapron ki target market Eid ya shaadiyon ki tayyari karne wale log hain.

book_ref.quote: This involves identifying potential customers, their needs, and how your product can address those needs

blocks.prompt:
31 What is a marketing plan? Give the book's example.
(Marketing plan kya hai? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Marketing plan target market tak pohanchne ki strategies bayan karta hai, jin mein social media, television ya zubani tashheer jaise channels chunna shamil hai. Misal: Pakistani masalon ka naya brand cooking shows ya khanon wale influencers ke zariye ishtehar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A marketing plan details the strategies for reaching your target market

blocks.prompt:
32 What are sales strategies? Give an example from Pakistan.
(Sales strategies kya hain? Pakistan se aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Sales strategies customers ko product khareedne par amada karne ki tactics hain, jaise discount, promotions ya behtareen customer service. Misal: Ramazan mein grocery stores khane ki cheezon par khaas deals dete hain jis se log zyada miqdar mein khareedte hain.

book_ref.quote: This might include offering discounts, running promotions, or providing excellent customer service

blocks.prompt:
33 Give a reason: many Pakistani businesses increase advertising during Ramadan and Eid.
(Wajah batayein: bohat se Pakistani kaarobar Ramazan aur Eid mein ishtehar kyun barha dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ramazan aur Eid mein log zyada khareedari karte hain, is liye us waqt ishtehar barhana sales barhane aur tehwar ke mausam se poora faida uthane ka strategic tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: Many Pakistani businesses increase their advertising efforts during Ramadan and Eid

blocks.prompt:
34 How does the Lahore start-up selling handmade jewelry online target its market?
(Lahore ka online haath ke bane zewar bechne wala start-up apni market ko kaise target karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Instagram aur Facebook jaise social media par apne products dikhata hai, local influencers ke saath mil kar apni pohanch barhata hai, aur shaadiyon ke season mein mehdood waqt ke discounts de kar sales barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a small start-up in Lahore that sells handmade jewelry online

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between revenue and profit.
(Revenue aur profit mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Revenue bechne se kul aamdani hai; profit tamam kharche nikal kar bachne wali raqam hai.

book_ref.quote: If the total costs for the shop are Rs. 30,000

rows: Cheezein ya services bech kar kul kamai
Kaarobar ke tamam kharche nikal kar bachne wali raqam
Revenue = bechi gayi tadad x qeemat
Profit = Revenue - Kharche
Kitab: 100 bags x Rs. 500 = Rs. 50,000

blocks.prompt:
36 A stall sells 80 lunch boxes at Rs. 250 each and its total costs are Rs. 12,500. Find its revenue and profit.
(Stall 80 lunch boxes Rs. 250 fi box bechta hai aur kul kharche Rs. 12,500 hain. Revenue aur profit maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Revenue = 80 x 250 = Rs. 20,000
Profit = Revenue - Kharche = 20,000 - 12,500 = Rs. 7,500

book_ref.quote: If a shop in Lahore sells 100 school bags at Rs. 500 each

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between investment and savings.
(Investment aur savings mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Investment paisa mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye lagati hai; savings paisa mustaqbil ki zarooraton ke liye alag rakhti hain.

book_ref.quote: A business saves a portion of its profits to purchase new equipment

rows: Kaarobar ya project mein raqam lagana
Mustaqbil ki zarooraton ke liye paisa alag rakhna
Maqsad: mustaqbil ka munafa
Maqsad: saman khareedna, kaarobar barhana ya achanak kharche
Misal: store Rs. 50,000 ka naya maal leta hai taake zyada mein beche
Misal: restaurant naye oven ke liye har mahine Rs. 10,000 rakhta hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Rs. 10.000' chhapa hai (full stop ke saath); sahi raqam Rs. 10,000 (das hazaar rupay) har mahina hai.

blocks.prompt:
38 A bakery takes a loan of Rs. 150,000 at 6% interest per year. How much must it repay after one year?
(Bakery Rs. 150,000 ka loan 6% salana interest par leti hai. Aik saal baad kitna wapas karna hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Interest = 6% x 150,000 = Rs. 9,000
Kul wapsi = Loan + Interest = 150,000 + 9,000 = Rs. 159,000

book_ref.quote: Interest is the cost of borrowing money

blocks.prompt:
39 Define loan and interest.
(Loan aur interest ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Loan: udhaar liya hua paisa jo kaarobar zaroorat se kam paisa hone par bank ya maali idare se leta hai aur interest ke saath wapas karna hota hai.
Interest: paisa udhaar lene ki qeemat, jo aam taur par loan ki raqam ka percentage hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: they take out a loan from a bank or another financial institution

blocks.prompt:
40 What is a budget? Why should a business compare it with actual expenses?
(Budget kya hai? Kaarobar ko ise asal kharchon se kyun milana chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Budget aisa mansooba hai jo andaza lagata hai ke kaarobar ke mukhtalif shobon (kiraya, bijli paani, tankhwahein, khaam maal) ke liye kitna paisa chahiye. Budget aur asal kharchon ka muqabla batata hai ke kaarobar zyada kharch kar raha hai ya bacha raha hai.

book_ref.quote: a plan that estimates how much money will be needed for different areas of the business

blocks.prompt:
41 A tailoring shop plans: rent Rs. 90,000, cloth Rs. 60,000, salaries Rs. 120,000 and utilities Rs. 30,000 per month. Find its total monthly budget.
(Silai ki dukaan ka mahana mansooba: kiraya Rs. 90,000, kapra Rs. 60,000, tankhwahein Rs. 120,000 aur bijli paani Rs. 30,000. Kul mahana budget maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: A bakery in Rawalpindi might have the following monthly budget

blocks.prompt:
42 Define communication. Differentiate between verbal and non-verbal communication.
(Communication ki definition likhein. Verbal aur non-verbal communication mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Communication doosron ke saath maloomat, khayalat ya ehsasat ke tabadle ka amal hai.

book_ref.quote: Communication is the process of exchanging information, ideas, or feelings with others

rows: Bolna ya likhna
Ishare ya chehre ke taassurat
Misal: presentation mein wazeh bolna
Misal: nazar milana aur aitmaad se khare hona

blocks.prompt:
43 Name three things that make communication effective when presenting a class project.
(Class project pesh karte waqt communication ko mo'assar banane wali teen cheezein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Wazeh bolna: aise bolna ke sab aasani se samjhein
2. Achhi body language: ishare, nazar milana aur aitmaad se khare hona
3. Sunna: audience ke sawalon ka jawab dena aur un ki raye par ghaur karna

book_ref.quote: Imagine you have a class project on environmental conservation

blocks.prompt:
44 Define storytelling. How can it help in a debate?
(Storytelling ki definition likhein. Debate mein yeh kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Storytelling alfaz, tasveeron aur jazbaat se aisi kahani banana hai jo sunne walon ko jor le. Debate mein yeh daleel ko dilchasp aur qaail karne wala banati hai, jaise plastic bags ke debate mein beach par plastic se samundari zindagi ko nuqsan ki kahani.

book_ref.quote: Storytelling involves using words, images, and emotions to create a narrative that engages the audience

blocks.prompt:
45 Write any four tips to improve communication and storytelling skills.
(Communication aur storytelling ki salahiyat behtar karne ki koi chaar tips likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Baqaida mashq: zyada bolne se aitmaad barhta hai
2. Audience ko jaanein: paigham sunne walon ke mutabiq
3. Visual aids: tasveerein, diagrams aur props
4. Wazeh aur mukhtasar: ghair zaroori tafseel se bachein
(Aur: awaz aur chehre se jazbaat dikhayein.)

book_ref.quote: Here are some tips to improve your communication and storytelling skills

blocks.prompt:
46 Define iteration with the book's logo example.
(Kitab ki logo wali misal ke saath iteration ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Iteration ka matlab hai feedback ki bunyad par tabdeeliyan karte hue amal dohrana taake matloob nateeja qareeb aaye. Misal: class logo banati, raye leti, rang aur shaklein badalti, phir raye leti aur yeh dohrati hai jab tak sab aakhri logo par razi na hon.

book_ref.quote: This cycle of designing, gathering feedback, and refining continues until you have a final logo

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between collaboration and iteration.
(Collaboration aur iteration mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Collaboration logon ke mil kar kaam karne ka naam hai; iteration kaam ko dohrane aur behtar karne ka.

book_ref.quote: When you collaborate, you can pool your knowledge and skills to solve complex problems

rows: Do ya zyada log mushtarka maqsad ke liye mil kar kaam karte hain
Matloob nateeje ke qareeb aane ke liye amal dohrana
Khayalat, wasail aur koshishein share
Feedback par tabdeeliyan aur behtari
Ilm aur hunar jor kar mushkil masail hal
Har qadam par kaam behtar hota hai
Misal: students ka mil kar science model banana
Misal: raye ke baad school event ka logo badalna

blocks.prompt:
48 Define innovation. How is mobile banking an example of it?
(Innovation ki definition likhein. Mobile banking is ki misal kaise hai?)
blocks.explanation: Innovation naye khayalat, products ya tareeqe banana hai jo numayan tabdeeli ya behtari layein, mojooda cheezon ko behtar banana bhi.
